title: Move Outlook messages to a chosen folder with AI
h1: move an outlook email into the right folder
description: Have a bot move an Outlook email into the right folder, checking the email and the folder before anything moves.
keyword: outlook move email to folder with ai
answer: a bot can move an outlook message from its current folder into another folder in the same mailbox. it finds the exact email and destination folder before filing. moving is a write, which the sending approval setting does not cover; ask explicitly for a preview if you want one.
og_line: a known message in a known folder.
what:
the bot finds the email and the folder first, then moves it. it won't guess a folder from a similar name.

if a move fails, ask the bot to find the email again before retrying. this action moves mail within one user's mailbox, not into another person's inbox.
uses: file a completed warranty claim under its existing project folder
move an event confirmation out of the inbox after adding its details to your plan
return an incorrectly filed message to the intended folder
keep an agreed supplier thread's individual messages in the same mailbox folder

routine.message: every friday at 11:55, find outlook messages i marked ready to file in this chat for oakmarsh warranties. look up the existing "warranties / completed" folder and show the selected subjects and destination here before moving them. after i confirm, move only those messages and report each result. never create folders, delete mail or guess which email i mean.
routine.needs: outlook connected, with read and write access to the mailbox folders
routine.output:
oakmarsh warranties filing plan
message: replacement hinge confirmation
destination: warranties / completed
full message and folder references found. awaiting your confirmation.

steps: choose the correct mailbox in **Connected apps** and permit **read and write** for the filing bot.
ask it to list folders and identify your destination before giving it a move request.
check one message subject and the destination folder, then put the approval checkpoint in the routine.
verify the destination after the first move and use **Pause** if any filing rule becomes unclear.
watch: if a move fails, ask the bot to find the email again and try once more.
move a big batch a few at a time.

faq.q: can it make a new folder if it's missing?
faq.a: no. this only moves mail into a folder you already have. make the folder in outlook first.

faq.q: will this move mail into a colleague's mailbox?
faq.a: the action moves a message between folders within the specified user's mailbox. transferring to another mailbox is not what it does.
